LinearStudy.powerSeriesQuotient_polynomial_diagonal.{u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {n : ℕ}
  (H : Fin (n + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) K) (hzero : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (H i) = 0)
  [IsArtinianRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) K ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range H))]
  (P : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) (hpzero : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (P i) = 0)
  (hp : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H))) ↑(P i) = 0) :
  let Q := MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) K ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range H);
  have q := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H));
  ∃ N,
    (N.mulVec MvPowerSeries.X = fun i => ↑(P i)) ∧
      ∃ M,
        LinearStudy.Annihilates (KaehlerDifferential.ideal K Q) M.det ∧
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' K) M.det = Matrix.det fun i j => q ↑((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (P i))) ∧
            (LinearStudy.pairingRightReduction (LinearStudy.powerSeriesQuotientAugmentation H hzero)) M.det = q N.det

LinearStudy.polynomial_universal_differe.formalType:
LinearStudy.polynomial_universal_difference_matrix.{u_1, u_2} {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [Fintype ι]
  [DecidableEq ι] (P : ι → MvPolynomial ι R) (hzero : ∀ (i : ι), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (P i) = 0) :
  ∃ D,
    ((D.mulVec fun i => MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i) - MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr i)) = fun i =>
        (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl) (P i) - (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr) (P i)) ∧
      (∀ (i j : ι), LinearStudy.polynomialDoubleDiagonal (D i j) = (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (P i)) ∧
        (D.map ⇑LinearStudy.polynomialDoubleRightZero).mulVec MvPowerSeries.X = fun i => ↑(P i)

ExteriorAlgebra.exists_decomp.formalType:
ExteriorAlgebra.exists_decomp.{u, u_1} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (i : ℕ)
  (z : ExteriorAlgebra R (M × R)) :

koszulComplex.appendMap_d_eq_pos.formalType:

  koszulComplex.d (koszulComplex.appendMap φ a) (n + 1) ∘ₗ ↑(exteriorPowerProdEquivProd R M (n + 1)) =
    ↑(exteriorPowerProdEquivProd R M n) ∘ₗ
      (LinearMap.inl R ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) ↥(⋀[R]^n M) ∘ₗ
            koszulComplex.d φ (n + 1) ∘ₗ LinearMap.fst R ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1 + 1) M) ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) +
          LinearMap.inr R ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) ↥(⋀[R]^n M) ∘ₗ
            koszulComplex.d φ n ∘ₗ LinearMap.snd R ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1 + 1) M) ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) +
        (-1) ^ (n + 1) •
          a • LinearMap.inl R ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) ↥(⋀[R]^n M) ∘ₗ LinearMap.snd R ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1 + 1) M) ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1) M))

scope: Geometric Linearity Theorem NOT proved. Checked regular-sequence determinant annihilator generation by lifted Koszul comparisons; nonzero scalar socle generation for actual Artinian multivariable power-series complete intersections; and a perfect-pairing corollary with explicit finite-dimensionality. Also checked the actual constant-coefficient augmentation and trace-element formula, parameter-specialization quotient isomorphism with Jacobian compatibility, and regularity of specialized equations derived from flatness. Previous relative pairing lifts, arbitrary-parameter quotient Artinian/maximal-ideal conclusions and coordinate helpers are retained. The actual multivariable derivative Jacobian is proved nonzero and scalar-generates the socle of regular finite-dimensional Artinian power-series quotients over characteristic-zero fields. Actual pairing diagonals, trace comparison, finite polynomial unit changes and nonzero right augmentation are constructed. The relative Jacobian theorem, arbitrary parameter lifts and global geometry remain unproved.

main.title: Linearity Theorem
setup: 设 f:ℙⁿ→ℙⁿ 为满射自态射，代数次数 q>1；V⊆ℙⁿ 为整的闭子簇，且 f⁻¹(V)=V（集合意义）。当前 Lean 目标用复数域上的齐次素理想、无基点齐次坐标组及真实 projective points 表述。

Let f:ℙⁿ→ℙⁿ be a surjective endomorphism of algebraic degree q>1. Let V⊆ℙⁿ be an integral closed subvariety with f⁻¹(V)=V set-theoretically. The current Lean target uses homogeneous prime ideals over ℂ, base-point-free coordinate forms and actual projective points.
result: 则 V 是线性子空间。完整定理尚未证明。坐标目标与概形原文的完整比较、任意特征零代数闭域的推广也尚未验证。

Then V is a linear subspace. The full theorem remains unproved. Full comparison with the Scheme statement and extension to arbitrary algebraically closed characteristic-zero fields are also unverified.

nodes.formalType:
LinearStudy.powerSeries_coefficientDeterminant_socle.{u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {n : ℕ}
  (H : Fin (n + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) K)
  (hH : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) K) (List.ofFn H))
  (hzero : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (H i) = 0)
  [IsArtinianRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) K ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range H))] :
  ∃ M,
    M.mulVec MvPowerSeries.X = H ∧
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H))) M.det ≠ 0 ∧
        Submodule.annihilator
            (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H))) (MvPowerSeries.X i))) =
          Ideal.span {(Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H))) M.det}

nodes.formalType:
LinearStudy.finiteFlat_closedFiber_traceElement.{u_5} {F : Type u_5} [Field F] {r n : ℕ}
